verdict_reason: The file is a pre-EUDPA-696 module brought back by a bad rebase resolution, and it reverts main's commodity-grouped review cards, which is outside this ticket's scope.

todos.issue: Commit 714a8f5 ('Fix rebase onto main') re-adds this file, which main deleted in EUDPA-696 (#484, commit 32236d4) when the review moved to one card per commodity with a species block per species (species-block.js, commodity-cards.js). On the PR head, sections/description-of-goods.js imports speciesCards (species-cards.js:6,19 calls speciesCardTitle) instead of main's commodityCards, so commodity-cards.js and species-block.js have no importer and the live-animals review reverts to the pre-Design-Release-2.1 per-species cards titled by lineTitle. EUDPA-776 asks only to remove the contact address page; rolling back merged EUDPA-696 review behaviour is outside its scope and breaks that ticket's agreed review layout. The same revert brings back species-card-title.test.js, species-cards.js, species-card-rows.js, species-card-actions.js, units-for-commodity-line.js, identifier-table.js and commodities/line-title.js.
todos.fix: Must: the PR's diff against main contains no species-card-title.js (or the other files EUDPA-696 deleted), and the review's Description of the goods section builds its cards from main's commodityCards/speciesBlock, with only the contact-address removal on top. One way: re-resolve the rebase by taking main's check-answers view-model (description-of-goods.js, cards/consignment/*) and reapplying only the EUDPA-776 contact-address deletions, then delete this file and the other resurrected pre-EUDPA-696 modules and tests
